Date: Tue, 14 Aug 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: SOC 2 Type II package (audit period clarification + bridge letter)

Hi Monica,

We are running our vendor security review for Q3 and need your SOC 2 Type II package. Can you please share:

- The most recent SOC 2 Type II report PDF (covering the audit period)
- A bridge letter describing any gap coverage if the report window doesn't include our expected evaluation window (we are targeting 2028-05-01 through 2029-04-30)
- A short checklist of artifacts you can provide on request (logs, change control, access lists, config snapshots)

Also: would you prefer SFTP, secure Drive share, or a direct DocuSign/transfer for sensitive files? Our procurement needs a statement of how long audit logs are retained and whether you have customer-managed KMS options.

Can we get an ETA by EOD PT tomorrow? Our audit kickoff is next week.

Thanks,
Janet Wu
Security Program Manager
Acme Analytics
janet.wu@acme-analytics.com
From: monica_patel@redwood.com <monica_patel@redwood.com>

Date: Tue, 14 Aug 2028 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 Type II package (audit period clarification + bridge letter)

Hi Janet —

Thanks for reaching out and for the clear asks. Quick answers up front: we can provide the Type II report (PDF) and a bridge letter if the audit window you listed extends beyond our current report coverage. We typically retain primary audit artifacts for 18 months and operational logs for 12 months by default; longer retention options are available under dedicated/private contracts.

Preferred transfer options:
- Secure Drive share (limited-domain link, short expiry) — easiest for bundles
- SFTP (read-only account) — good for bulk logs/archives
- Encrypted zip over DocuSign only for signed NDA/contract additions

Attached: redwood_soc2_evidence_checklist_v2.pdf (high-level list of what we can provide) and a sample bridge letter (redwood_bridge_letter_sample.docx).

Two clarifying Qs for your team: 1) For the audit period you mentioned (2028-05-01 to 2029-04-30) — are you expecting a report that fully overlaps that window or is a report that covers a recent 12-month span acceptable with a bridge letter describing changes since the report? 2) Please tell us which artifacts you prioritize (examples: config change logs, SIEM log samples, KMS key policy, endpoint patching evidence).

If it helps, David (security operations) can share an anonymized sample of retention logs and Neha (compliance) can run through the bridge-letter wording.

Best,

Monica Patel
Senior Security & Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

Attachment stubs:
- redwood_soc2_evidence_checklist_v2.pdf (PDF)
- redwood_bridge_letter_sample.docx (DOCX)

Hi Monica —

Thanks for the quick reply and the attachments. A full report that overlaps our window would be ideal, but a current Type II with a bridge letter explaining the gap is acceptable.

Priority artifacts for our review team:
1) SIEM log samples (past 30 days) and a statement of retention policy
2) Evidence of privileged access reviews and access lists for owners/admins
3) Change control tickets for production deployments in the audit period window
4) KMS key policy and whether customer-managed keys are supported

SFTP for bulk logs + secure Drive link for the report and bridge letter would work well. Can you also confirm whether you collect full request/response bodies in logs (we only need headers/metadata for now)?

We need a secure share by EOD PT tomorrow if possible — can you confirm?

Janet
From: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
To: Janet Wu <janet.wu@acme-analytics.com>
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 14 Aug 2028 15:43:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 Type II package (audit period clarification + bridge letter)

Janet —

Appreciate the priorities. Quick notes and plan of action: 

- We will provide the latest SOC 2 Type II report PDF and an explicit bridge letter that states audit window coverage and what changed since the report. The bridge letter will include: scope, covered controls, timeline of changes, and where to find compensating controls. (See attached sample.)

- SIEM logs: we can provide 30-day anonymized SIEM samples (headers/metadata only). Full request/response bodies are not stored centrally for more than 7 days and are redacted in artifacts we share by default. If you require bodies for a narrow set of requests, we can discuss a scoped capture under an NDA.

- Privileged access evidence: we will supply an access list export and the most recent privileged access review report (redacted names where appropriate).

- Change control: we will provide a CSV export of production change tickets for the specified audit window (ticket IDs, dates, approval owners, short description) and a few representative ticket attachments.

- KMS: Redwood supports cloud-managed KMS by default and customer-managed keys (BYOK) for Private deployments; we will include the KMS policy excerpt.

Transfer plan: 
1) Drive link (expiring 14 days, restricted to acme-analytics.com) for the report and bridge letter.
2) SFTP read-only account for logs (credentials to be shared via separate encrypted email).

ETA: We will stage the Drive package and SFTP upload by EOB PT tomorrow (2028-08-15 17:00 PT).

Attachments included in the staged package:
- redwood_soc2_evidence_checklist_v2.pdf
- redwood_bridge_letter_sample.docx
- sftp_instructions.txt

If that schedule works, I will send the Drive link and SFTP creds to this thread and a secure push to your procurement contact.
